name: Historic City of Meknes
description: Meknes, in northern central Morocco, began as an 11th-century Almoravid military camp. It rose to glory as the capital of Sultan Moulay Ismaïl, who ruled from 1672 to 1727. He ringed the city with towering walls and monumental gateways, and built a vast palace complex. Its Spanish-Moorish style blends Islamic and European touches from 17th-century North Africa.
